posts.name: Beyond The Dialogue
posts.tagline: Persistent characters that remember, evolve, and own
posts.description: Give every NPC persistent AI memory and a Solana identity, so their personality, relationships, achievements, and inventory live beyond the dialogue.

posts.name: Polishory
posts.tagline: Get a clear plan to improve your website and prevent AI slop
posts.description: Website feels generic? Polishory reviews your public URL on desktop and mobile, with design scores, screenshot-backed feedback, and prioritized recommendations. See what to change in your layout, typography, and spacing, without touching your code.

posts.name: retailog
posts.tagline: Turn supplier PDFs into eshop ready import CSVs
posts.description: Turn supplier PDF catalogs into import-ready Shopify and WooCommerce CSVs. Get a free sample conversion of your first 10-20 products.

posts.name: PokeCode Pocket Localized Vibecoding App
posts.tagline: Localized Mobile Phone vibecoding and prompt management
posts.description: Most mobile vibe-coding apps rely on SSH or cloud computers. Pokecode takes a different approach: it runs locally on your phone through a Linux environment, with a clean, mobile-first interface. It also includes built-in prompt management, letting you organize, version, link, and reuse prompts across projects, keeping AI-assisted development structured instead of turning into a messy chat history.

posts.name: crayon.live · homework comes alive
posts.tagline: Turn tonight's homework into a game they ask to play again
posts.description: Photograph your child's homework. crayon.live reads the answers they wrote, finds the ones they got wrong, and builds a game around those. Their own wrong answer is one of the choices, so they have to think it through instead of recognizing a shape. Each game is written fresh by GPT-6 Astra, then played to the end by the machine that made it before anyone sees it. This began as an entry for OpenAI's Astra Challenge, built at the kitchen table. It might stay a side project. It might not.

posts.name: Snappit
posts.tagline: Identify any animal and collect it as a Pokemon card
posts.description: Snap a photo to identify plants, animals, birds, and bugs. A free, kid-safe nature app for families — collect discoveries and turn every walk into an adventure.

posts.name: MeltDots
posts.tagline: Turn pictures you love into bead patterns you can make
posts.description: Your cat. A little doodle. A gift in someone's favorite colors. MeltDots turns photos and ideas into fuse bead patterns you can make by hand. Start with an image, explore the pattern library, or try AI. Simplify a busy photo, choose your bead palette, and edit each bead until the design feels yours. Download a PNG with the grid, color legend, and bead counts. Direct conversion and editing are free; downloads need a free account. AI uses credits.

posts.name: LOOPHOLE
posts.tagline: Find the exploits hiding in your rules
posts.description: LOOPHOLE is a private-by-default workbench for exploring fictional economies. Turn rules into a world, find a loophole, and replay the proof.

posts.name: LessBill - AI Cloud Cost Engineer
posts.tagline: Validate. Optimize. Save.
posts.description: LessBill is a multi-cloud AI cost engineer for AWS, Azure & GCP. It doesn’t just show your bill - it investigates why your costs are rising. It finds idle and underused resources and identifies where money is being wasted. AI gives actionable recommendations with estimated savings and explains why each change matters. Teams can validate, approve, and act on recommendations from one place.

posts.name: Second Eyes
posts.tagline: Automatically shortlist photos for faster publishing
posts.description: Second Eyes helps you sort photos, understand the shortlist, and make the final call. For business briefs or personal needs, see why each photo was shortlisted and what still needs checking. You decide what to publish. Explore a real media editorial project involving 404 source files, then try six public sample photos to see how your requirements reshape the shortlist. This demo uses a recorded review. No uploads yet. Would you use this with your own photos? Share your workflow in the comments.

posts.name: Charted
posts.tagline: Your Travel Map
posts.description: A personal travel map and journal. Mark the places you have been, save the details, and watch your world fill with color.

posts.name: Fallow
posts.tagline: Codebase intelligence for TypeScript and JavaScript
posts.description: Run npx fallow audit in any TypeScript or JavaScript repository. Fallow builds a deterministic dependency graph, then reports unused code, cycles, duplicated logic, complexity, and architecture drift. Its changed-code gate blocks only findings introduced by the current change, so existing debt does not stop adoption. Use the same evidence locally, in CI, editors, and MCP workflows. The analyzer is free and MIT licensed; optional Fallow Runtime adds production execution evidence.

posts.name: prop.GIS™
posts.tagline: GIS mapping built for field service operations
posts.description: prop.GIS™ is an alternative GIS mapping + field operations platform built for field-service companies burdened by missed work, unclear job scope, and costly truck re-rolls. Map every property in detail, create custom markings, add notes and photos, build routes, dispatch alerts, manage assets, and coordinate crews from one operational system. Founding 100 members get early access benefits as we scale with real-world operators.

posts.name: JigBench
posts.tagline: Your workbench for reusable AI prompts
posts.description: JigBench is a local-first prompt workbench for people using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or another AI tool. Choose from 10 focused commands, combine compatible steps, add your material, and inspect the full prompt before copying it into your preferred AI tool. No account or API key required. No AI model runs inside JigBench. Saved workflows keep command choices and order locally in your browser, without saving your material.

posts.name: BBSide
posts.tagline: An AI-powered platform for local businesses
posts.description: BBSide combines capabilities that competitors usually separate: AI-generated business pages, service bookings, product orders, payments, customer communication, multilingual local discovery, and dynamic geolocation. Unlike booking-first platforms, every provider receives a shareable storefront that delivers value even before the marketplace reaches scale. Providers can acquire customers through social media, messages, referrals, and search while becoming part of a live local network.

posts.name: Vera
posts.tagline: Accounting checks and reports, prepared inside Codex
posts.description: Open the ChatGPT marketplace, search for "accounting", and install Vera. Vera brings accounting workflows to Codex: reconciliations, entry checks and reviewable workbooks and reports. For the GPT-6 Astra Challenge on September 18, we’re showcasing budgeting and reporting improvements developed with Astra in Codex. Try the interactive Sites demo: Actual/Budget comparisons, year-end forecasts, € and % variances, and IBCS-style charts and tables, using synthetic data.

posts.name: CronMon: What runs on this Mac and when?
posts.tagline: Every cron and launchd job on your Mac, and why it never ran
posts.description: A macOS menu bar app that lists every cron job and scheduled launchd agent with the next run in plain English, a 24-hour timeline, honest run history, and a diagnosis when a job never fires (wrong PATH, no Full Disk Access, output mailed to nowhere).

posts.name: COREY
posts.tagline: Check and fix IFC model data *visually* in your browser
posts.description: COREY helps BIM teams review IFC building data in 3D, configure checks, and find missing or incorrect values. Filter problem elements in a data table, export to Excel for bulk edits, import the changes, and validate again. Visual. Simple. Reuseable. Free and open source.

posts.name: AccessForge
posts.tagline: Make accessibility journeys explicit and auditable
posts.description: AccessForge is an open-source workspace for accessibility journey authoring and evidence-oriented review. Define user goals, independent success criteria, permitted origins and bounded actions; manage access and inspect desktop-runner readiness. Built with Codex. This preview demonstrates the deployed workspace and authoring flow; real VoiceOver/NVDA baseline, repair and independent rerun evidence are not yet demonstrated.

posts.name: Manifest 2 Meatspace
posts.tagline: Turn a text prompt into a physical 3D print
posts.description: Manifest 2 Meatspace is an interactive art installation that turns a text prompt or image into a ready-to-print 3D object. Built with Python, Docker, an image generation model, Kiln3D and a Bambu P1S, it automates image creation, 3D modelling, validation, slicing and printer delivery—while asking what form a personal AI would choose in the physical world.

posts.name: Coffeehouse Chess
posts.tagline: Play chess with an AI opponent you can talk to
posts.description: Play chess with five AI personalities that talk back and remember your games. Speak your moves, discuss the position, and play in your browser or on a Chessnut Move with automatic piece movement. A dedicated chess engine chooses the moves. Free to try.

posts.name: Alternaut
posts.tagline: Better software, without hours of research
posts.description: Millions of people still use software that’s outdated, overpriced, bloated with ads, or simply no longer the best option. Great apps already exist. We help you find them. We scan the applications on your device and find the best alternatives for your needs. Every recommendation is backed by research, so you free up time to actually use the better tools instead of endlessly searching for them. So, what are you waiting for? It's time to level up your software stack.

posts.name: Aside
posts.tagline: Turn ANY listening to conversation.
posts.description: Meet Aside. Turn any audio into a conversation. Interrupt a podcast with a question. Go deeper into a lecture. Explore the thinking behind an interview. Join any listening just like talking with your friends over Discord. Recorded then. Your turn now. Don’t just listen. Join in!

posts.name: Design Arc
posts.tagline: Evidence-backed product journeys before you build
posts.description: Design Arc is a Codex plugin that turns vague product feedback into a complete, evidence-backed design direction. It confirms the outcome, audits the real user journey, checks decisions against official platform guidance and optional Mobbin benchmarks, recommends the strongest path, and designs every important state before implementation. Human approval gates preserve control, while optional Google Stitch exploration helps teams compare and refine visual proposals.

posts.name: Grabl
posts.tagline: A shelf for files in progress. Holds them till you need them
posts.description: Moving one file between two apps shouldn't mean digging through Downloads. Grabl is an always-on-top shelf pinned to your screen edge: drag files, links, and images in, keep them in folders, and drag them out into any app. Hotkey or mouse-shake to summon.

posts.name: ChinaMarketing.AI GEO Workspace
posts.tagline: From Chinese AI evidence to implementation with Astra
posts.description: ChinaMarketing.AI GEO Workspace shows brands how they appear across Chinese AI discovery journeys, then turns evidence-backed gaps into implementation-ready action. GEO Actions uses GPT-6 Astra to create channel-specific assets from verified brand facts, check material claims against those facts, route them through human approval, and record the exact version implemented.

posts.name: UItopic
posts.tagline: Curated UI sections and components, updated daily.
posts.description: A hand-picked library of real product UI, sorted by what you are actually looking for, with the designer credited on every single piece. Replace the screenshots folder, the Pinterest board and the twelve tabs you left open, with one library you can search.

posts.name: Build My Event
posts.tagline: The booking system for UK event suppliers
posts.description: Booking software for UK event suppliers. Turn any enquiry — a DM, a referral, a repeat client — into a priced proposal, a signed contract and a deposit in your account. No lead fees, ever. Free to start, or £29/month with no platform fee.

posts.name: Birthday Traffic
posts.tagline: How rare is your birthday? Rank it against 85.7M others
posts.description: Birthday Traffic turns official birth records into a personal birthday reveal. Pick any date to see how rare it is across 85.7M U.S. births, explore patterns from 7 countries, then turn the result into a birthday card you can customize and send as a link. No account or install. Built with GPT-6 Astra to reconcile messy public datasets and turn the research into a working, source-linked product.

posts.name: Troy
posts.tagline: Fine-tune LLMs on your MacBook with one YAML file
posts.description: Troy fine-tunes and preference-tunes LLMs locally on Apple Silicon. Write one YAML file, run troy train, then chat, eval, serve an OpenAI-compatible API, or export to GGUF/Ollama and even iPhone apps. Built on MLX. No CUDA, no cloud, no pipeline.

posts.name: WhyLab
posts.tagline: Find why your ML model fails, prove it, repair it
posts.description: WhyLab is an AI incident investigator built on GPT-6 Astra. Upload your model's predictions and Astra hunts for the root cause — ranking hypotheses, running falsification experiments on held-out data, and proposing a fix it then re-tests. No guesses presented as facts.

posts.name: Lastbox
posts.tagline: Put your AI to work on physical junk mail
posts.description: Give your AI a plan to reduce unwanted US postal mail. Lastbox guides Informed Delivery setup, mail review, and sender opt-outs. Choose what it can do, then copy the free prompt or open it in ChatGPT or Claude. Your AI handles account access.

posts.name: Mola
posts.tagline: Build your café, hire a team, and grow a coffee chain
posts.description: Mola is a cozy 3D café tycoon for Android. Serve customers, hire baristas and cleaners, arrange furniture, and expand across three districts. As your café gets busier, balance queues, stock, seating, and staff. Built with GPT-6 Astra through a player-directed process: describe an idea, play the build, and refine what happens. Free to play with optional purchases. Available in English and Turkish.

posts.name: X-Radio.FM
posts.tagline: Radio for Founders Building in Public
posts.description: Live 24/7 radio for founders building in public. Hear launches, first dollars, and hard weeks posted on X, rewritten and read aloud by the host.

posts.name: Northstar — Revenue Intelligence Agents
posts.tagline: Agents for sales and product teams. Built in control plane.
posts.description: Clairio Northstar helps sales and product teams act on what is really happening — combining CRM signals, product signals, and actual MRR/ARR data from Stripe etc. Integrated with CRM and Jira. Takes raw data and allows you to work as a team not the usual silos. Find what customers really want and will pay for. The agents are managed by a built in control plane, which will also allow for agent management across your enterprise (coming soon). Try for free.

posts.name: TapeOutTank
posts.tagline: Battle a fruit-fly-inspired tank. Inspect its circuit brain.
posts.description: Built with GPT-6 Astra in Codex, TapeOutTank turns trained controllers into playable circuit NFTs. Challenge Atlas, Swift or a 64-node fruit-fly-derived network; watch them duel, inspect decisions and download replays. Fly11 is deployed on BNB Chain as 36 child circuits plus a root NFT. Free to play, no wallet needed. Matches run off-chain; the fly is a trained subnetwork, not a whole-brain simulation.

posts.name: PresentCast
posts.tagline: Cast PDF, Images and Videos to Smart TV
posts.description: PresentCast turns multiple PDFs, photos, and videos into reusable presentation playlists you can prepare, rehearse, and present from your iPhone or iPad. and support Cast to Smart TV. Plan the order before the session, keep the current and next content visible in Presenter View, follow elapsed time, and control the presentation without rebuilding a queue for every meeting, lesson, pitch, or event.

posts.name: AGENTCODI
posts.tagline: Native Android workspace for sandboxed coding agents
posts.description: AGENTCODI brings a native AI coding workspace to Android. It runs the Codex app-server locally, includes a real terminal and development toolchains, and adds its own protected sandbox with approval controls for commands and file access. No Termux, no WebView shell, no separate gateway. - Mcpasi/AGENTCODI

posts.name: The Flight Steward
posts.tagline: Mobile order taking for Alaska Air Flight Attendants
posts.description: Eliminates paper order taking for Alaska Airlines First Class flight attendants. Snap a photo of the passenger manifest to instantly import names and pre-ordered meals. The app works completely offline on-device, making order taking and preparation seamless at 30,000 feet.

posts.name: SkiHub
posts.tagline: First Autonomous AI & SaaS Ecosystem forGlobal Outdoor Sport
posts.description: SkiHub Tech is a SportTech platform built from real-world mountain experience, combining the challenges of extreme outdoor conditions with today’s AI to make sports easier for millions. We’re building a year-round, cashless ecosystem powered by real-time AI Match, smart bookings, and autonomous AI agents for global onboarding.

posts.name: Dipping.ai
posts.tagline: Find buy-the-dip opportunities in stocks and industries
posts.description: Discover buy-the-dip opportunities in US stocks and industries. Dipping.ai scans the market for major stock drops and gathers company news, fundamentals, and market signals. Our AI turns that data into reports on potential upside and risks, ready for you to read. Browse the latest dips or explore industry pullbacks and the stocks within them. Built with GPT-6 Astra in Codex, with help across coding, branding, and demo production.

posts.name: Become Articulate
posts.tagline: Build vocabulary by learning words using real-world context
posts.description: Become Articulate is an AI-powered English vocabulary practice app designed to help you express yourself more clearly, naturally, and precisely. Build your personal word collection, practice words through unique AI-generated real-world contexts, and receive feedback as you actively recall and use each word. The goal is to turn passive vocabulary knowledge into words you can confidently use when you need them.

posts.name: ArtBloom
posts.tagline: create beyond imagination
posts.description: Create, edit, and share original AI artwork with ArtBloom's browser-based creative tools.

posts.name: Octadock
posts.tagline: Screen capture for Windows that stays on your PC
posts.description: Screenshots, text, voice and video from one little dock. No account, no subscription — every capture stays on your Windows PC. Local Shelf, Library, annotations, OCR and more.

posts.name: Yaps
posts.tagline: Private, powerful AI Super-App that runs on your device
posts.description: Yaps is your private AI super app, bringing powerful offline AI tools together on your device. Use speech-to-text to dictate into any app, transcribe audio and video, turn text into speech, chat with your Markdown notes, and create captions. Local AI models keep your data on your device and work entirely offline. No scripts to wrangle, no per-use cloud credits, just one AI assistant for your everyday work. Available on Mac, Windows, Linux, Android, iPhone and iPad.

posts.name: VectorizeThis - Image To SVG Converter
posts.tagline: ChatGPT/AI doesn't generate SVGs well, this fixes the issue
posts.description: Convert ChatGPT / AI-generated images into clean and lean SVGs. Built for web, development and design workflows: optimize and compress SVGs, edit detected colors, assign CSS classes or variables, use currentColor, and batch-convert up to 100 images at once. Everything runs locally in your browser.

posts.name: RankDots Opportunities
posts.tagline: Turn Google Search Console data into clear next steps
posts.description: RankDots Opportunities analyzes your Google Search Console data to find missing content, underperforming pages, quick wins, and structural issues. Every opportunity comes with a recommended action, so you know what to create, expand, split, or improve first.

posts.name: DiskWright
posts.tagline: See what fills your Mac. Review before you reclaim.
posts.description: A native Mac storage app for developers and anyone with a full SSD. Find large files, inspect logical vs allocated size, compare saved scans, and review cleanup before anything moves to Trash. Explore Xcode simulator storage and developer caches with context. File analysis stays on your Mac. Free to scan and inspect; $9 once for the version 1 paid features. No subscription.

posts.name: Digital Marketing Company
posts.tagline: Best SEO and Digital Marketing Company
posts.description: Boost your brand with Infiniti Techno, the Best Digital Marketing Company delivering expert SEO, PPC, and social media solutions for business growth.

posts.name: Veilig Wijdemeren
posts.tagline: A community safety app for Wijdemeren
posts.description: VeiligWijdemeren is a community safety app for the municipality of Wijdemeren. The app gives residents a clear safety score, shows risk locations, shares local updates, and makes it easier to report unsafe situations anonymously. It helps people stay informed without panic, with simple information about safety, reports, contact options, and local risk areas.

posts.name: Voodle Studio
posts.tagline: Turn a prompt, script, or PDF into a whiteboard video
posts.description: Describe a story, paste a script, or upload a PDF. Voodle Studio casts hand-drawn characters, writes scene-by-scene narration, records the voiceover, and inks every stroke with an animated drawing hand. Edit in the browser timeline, then export a shareable MP4.

posts.name: Silver Fox — Made with Astra
posts.tagline: A VTuber model built with Astra, from art to facial rigging
posts.description: Can Astra build a VTuber model? Silver Fox documents the result: original character art, layered parts, facial rigging, expressions, and a model running in VTube Studio. Facial modeling is partly working; the body and full-motion polish are still in progress.

posts.name: Bookdam
posts.tagline: Track your reading. Save the words worth remembering.
posts.description: Bookdam is a reading log for tracking what you're reading and saving the passages you want to remember. Snap a page, extract text with OCR, save quotes and notes, and revisit them anytime. Keep your reading history organized across iOS, Android, and the web.

posts.name: KlipZi City
posts.tagline: Tanks. Jetpacks. Hoverboards. Sharks. 4 Player Chaos.
posts.description: Jump into a free 3D chaos sandbox, solo or with friends. Drive tanks, planes, boats, helicopters and hoverboards. Strap on a jetpack, parachute from rooftops, swim with sharks, flip cars, shoot from vehicles, outrun cops and hunt each other in deathmatch. There’s even a flying time jump car that gets very interesting at 88 mph. No download. No account. Just play in a browser on web or mobile. Built by an Edinburgh designer with AI, then expanded into a multiplayer playground. Playing stays free.

posts.name: Ronda
posts.tagline: Every coding-agent session, searchable and open source
posts.description: Every good session with a coding agent contains something that then disappears into a hidden folder. Ronda indexes what Claude, Code, Codex, Cursor, and more than ten other agents already write to disk, allowing you to search everything and resume any session. Fully open source.

posts.name: Makersclaw 2.0
posts.tagline: The operating system for a company run by agents
posts.description: MakersClaw 2.0 turns a goal into the apps, agents and automations needed to get it done. We originally launched MakersClaw as AI employees that lived in Slack, Teams and Telegram. We rebuilt it around a different idea: instead of hiring an agent for a role, tell MakersClaw what you want done. It builds the tools for the job, runs them continuously, remembers the work and operates within a budget you set. Today it starts with go-to-market

posts.name: BugBnB
posts.tagline: A bed & breakfast for bugs. Your Trash is the kitchen.
posts.description: BugBnB is a native macOS menu bar app. It watches your Trash — when the bin gets big enough or old enough, five species move in: fruit flies, cockroaches, ants, drain flies and mosquitoes, and they don't fly at random. Ants lay pheromone trails and carry crumbs in a line, cockroaches run the screen edges, mosquitoes bite your idle cursor. Empty the Trash and a little garbage truck tips the bin. Pest control: shoo, spray, or flamethrower. Free, native, no account, no tracking. macOS 11+.

posts.name: Home Market View
posts.tagline: Home Value data and historical trends by city & zip code
posts.description: Explore home values, listings, sale prices, and rents across cities and ZIP codes across the USA

posts.name: FieldSign
posts.tagline: Run field service jobs from a QR code, no app install
posts.description: FieldSign runs field service end to end: work orders, asset registries, QR fault reporting, quotations, invoices, purchase orders and projects. The difference is the technician side — no app store, no seat licence, no password. Techs scan a QR code, do the job, capture the client signature on site, and a branded PDF report is emailed on completion. Flat pricing from $59/mo for the whole team, not per user. White-label, nightly encrypted backups, 14-day trial, no card.

posts.name: TapTick
posts.tagline: The swiss army knife for Mac
posts.description: An app launcher, script runner, menu bar customizer, and utilities hub. The swiss army knife for Mac. TapTick brings four essential Mac workflows together: - Applications: Launch, focus, or hide any app with a global shortcut. - Scripts: Write scripts then run them globally or display result in menu bar. - Menu Bar: Show live script output in customizable one-line or two-line slots. - Utilities: Keep focused Mac tools one shortcut away. Screen capture and mark, Large Type, and Keystroke Overlay.

posts.name: Tokyo AfterHours
posts.tagline: An open-city Tokyo racing playground in your browser
posts.description: Explore a compact Tokyo Bay, meet NPC rivals, chase local records and race friends. Cars, bikes, jumps, drifts and changing weather—all in your browser. Play solo without signing in; join online rooms with ChatGPT.

posts.name: Grupote
posts.tagline: Shared expenses made simple for every group
posts.description: Grupote is a simple way for friends, couples, roommates, travel groups, and associations to organize shared expenses. Create a group, record expenses and contributions, and clearly see where the money goes — without messy spreadsheets or endless chat messages. We built Grupote for Spanish-speaking users who want an easy and transparent way to manage money together. This is our first public launch, and we’d love to hear your feedback.

posts.name: Snooze Files
posts.tagline: Shelve messy files and restore them in one click
posts.description: Snooze Files is a small Mac app that temporarily moves files out of your way and brings them back to their original location when you’re ready. Works very similarly to Gmail snooze for emails. Right-click a file in Finder, choose Snooze File and pick a time - that's it. Your file will return to the same folder after that time. It’s a simple way to clear your desktop, put a document aside, or save something for next week.

posts.name: Draw - Hola Cloud
posts.tagline: Draw as you speak
posts.description: Explain, share and record your ideas as you speak. Draw shapes, arrows, text, images and more: all with a single tool. Simple. Focus on the explanation. Communicate with your team. Good for system design, APIs, technical interviews, sequence diagrams, architecture discussions, and more. Put everything on the same page. Literally.

posts.name: BlindDrop
posts.tagline: Keep your API keys and other secrets out of agent contexts
posts.description: BlindDrop lets agents use your API keys without ever seeing them. Imagine a password manager but for your secrets so agents never leak them into context, send them to remote servers, or accidentally misuse them in tools. BlindDrop handles the auth and shares it with your agents directly so your secrets stay hidden and safe.

posts.name: Mood Popper
posts.tagline: Feel it. Pop it. Make a little space.
posts.description: Mood Popper is a playful emotional check-in app for iOS. Explore your feelings through colourful mood bubbles, write in a private journal, follow breathing exercises, or take a break with fidget toys. A gentle, neurodivergent-friendly space with cosmic colour and a little play, designed to make checking in with yourself feel more approachable.

posts.name: WorthToTry
posts.tagline: The honest AI tool directory. List in 30 seconds.
posts.description: WorthToTry is a directory of AI tools organised by wat each one does, with pricing on every listing. Fouders list a product free — no badge, no backlink, noconditions. A coding agent can do the whole submissin on its own through a published skill, leaving the ounder a single confirmation link to click. Every liting is reviewed before it goes up, and no listing crries a rating, score or percentage we did not measue ourselves.

posts.name: woolgather
posts.tagline: Turn rough ideas into projects you can understand and build.
posts.description: woolgather helps developers and makers turn scattered ideas into projects they can understand and build. Capture thoughts freely, develop them through focused agentic conversations, and keep decisions, sources, open questions and next steps in one living plan.

posts.name: Rivetport
posts.tagline: Keep your API contract. Replace your backend.
posts.description: Rivetport helps teams move to a new API while preserving the contract their existing integrations depend on. Bring current and replacement API specifications into one workspace, review changes, test before publishing, and manage the transition with request visibility, pause controls, and rollback. Built for read-only JSON APIs.

posts.name: Duvi
posts.tagline: Make an AI for any business just using a URL
posts.description: Build AI agents by simply describing what you want. Duvi brings voice, chat and actions into one agent that knows your business, connects to your tools, and works across your website, phone and WhatsApp without building separate experiences for every channel.

posts.name: Mudd
posts.tagline: Team chat and project tasks with AI-assisted task extraction
posts.description: Mudd brings team chat, projects, and tasks into one workspace. Create tasks from conversations or review AI-suggested tasks before saving them. Each task links back to its source messages, so the discussion and the work stay connected.

posts.name: ScenoraEdits
posts.tagline: Turn scripts into consistent AI videos in 5 stages
posts.description: Most AI video tools give you 5-second random clips with morphing characters and drifting faces. **ScenoraEdits** is built differently — structured around a rigorous 5-Stage Studio Pipeline: 1. **Script & Voiceover Sync** 2. **Scene Clustering** 3. **Video Bible Consistency** 4. **Interactive Cinema Timeline** 5. **Full HD FFmpeg Export** 💡 **Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)**: Use your own OpenAI or Fal.ai keys for unlimited generation at zero markup, or run locally on your own GPU.

posts.name: Ubora Health
posts.tagline: Helping families find care
posts.description: Ubora Health helps families find care — care centers, skilled nursing, and home health near them. Browse listings and request information when ready.

posts.name: Tonerune is live! Free guitar lessons.
posts.tagline: Free guitar resources, music theory guides, lessons.
posts.description: We're building a personal resource that helps you. Without ads, fluff, or distractions. We want our platform free, open, and helpful. We are building more than a website or an app- we are building something that makes you think and reflect on what tethers you to music, and we are sharing what we find meaningful. We don't have AI features that will talk to you and make you feel good because we want you to pick up your guitar, not your phone. We want you curious.

posts.name: CurbKEA
posts.tagline: Free Stuff. Probably still there.
posts.description: Discover what’s out on the curb for free, and get alerts when something matching your wishlist pops up. Happy scavenging!

posts.name: Vayker
posts.tagline: Group travel, actually organized
posts.description: Vayker is a collaborative trip-planning app for group travel. Build your itinerary together in real time, split expenses automatically, invite friends with a simple 6-digit PIN, and use the built-in trip AI to generate a full itinerary in seconds. Everything — itinerary, expenses, and participants — synced live in one app. Free to start, on iOS and Android.

posts.name: Smashly - Badminton Tracker
posts.tagline: Score, Track & Learn Badminton
posts.description: Score matches in seconds, keep every result on record, and settle any rules debate instantly. Smashly is the fastest way to keep score in badminton, built for iPhone.

posts.name: RepoRoad
posts.tagline: The endless lo-fi drive where every repo is a building
posts.description: GitHub is where people pour years of their life — and it all arrives as a row in a list. RepoRoad gives some life to that list. Every repository is a building on one shared road: same road, same time, same lo-fi track for everyone on it. Stars set the height, a floor per 10,000. Explore projects, chat with visitors, send chickens across the road. Add your repo and design its building. Less leaderboard, more neighbourhood — would love to see your repo out there.

posts.name: Kennel by Waldo
posts.tagline: More intelligence. Less for you to carry.
posts.description: Tell Kennel your goal and it does the rest. Say "make a blue circle" - Kennel works out the size, colour, placement from what the project already knows. It forms a contract, and hands each piece of the goal to the best agents available (Codex, Claude, OpenCode, etc) under authority you grant / revoke. It manages the agent coordination and brings back what needs your judgment, and what's still open. No more babysitting agents or forgetting what you set out to do.

posts.name: SEION backoffice with AI
posts.tagline: Seion creates AI agents to make a business more efficient.
posts.description: SEION creates AI agents connected to your entire company They are not isolated chatbots: they connect to your ERP, your CRM, and your channels to consult data and perform real tasks. Create as many agents as you need, by department and by language.

posts.name: stocks.team
posts.tagline: Stock fundamentals for AI agents
posts.description: Give your AI agents financial facts they can trace to SEC filings. Query statements and metrics through REST or MCP, with reporting periods, source references, and point-in-time controls. Built with GPT-6 Astra. Coverage varies by company and filing.

posts.name: Neon Shift
posts.tagline: Multiplayer taxi chaos in your browser, built with Astra
posts.description: Race for fares in a neon city with friends or public lobbies. Dodge traffic, escape police and earn new rides: a bus, a jumping bike and a flying taxi drone. Free to play on desktop and mobile. Built with GPT-6 Astra in Codex.

posts.name: CiteRush AI
posts.tagline: Know how Google & AI sees your brand
posts.description: CiteRush AI helps businesses understand how they appear across search engines and AI-powered search. Audit your website, uncover SEO and GEO opportunities, monitor AI visibility, track competitors, and turn complex website data into actionable recommendations—all from one intelligence platform.

posts.name: MathPaperAI
posts.tagline: Write, proof, check and understand mathematical manuscripts
posts.description: Draft, structure and refine mathematical and scientific papers with AI-assisted explanations, fact-checking and rewriting. Connect with others to proof, explore and collaborate on mathematical domains. Use an advanced Lean proof pipeline to find new insights and new mathematics.

posts.name: LaterGator
posts.tagline: Schedule tabs for later, with AI that plans your day
posts.description: LaterGator reopens tabs when you need them. Save a link, hit +10m, +1h or +1d or custom. It pops back on schedule, with daily, weekly or monthly repeats. New now: Magic AI Organizer reads every open tab, bundles related ones into tasks and drafts a schedule for your day in one click. Google sign-in with cloud sync across devices, dark mode and a rebuilt UI. Free forever for manual scheduling. AI plans from $3.99/mo, or bring your own OpenRouter key.

posts.name: PC Anatomy
posts.tagline: Explore a PC from case to GPU core in interactive 3D
posts.description: PC Anatomy is an open source interactive 3D explorer for computer hardware. Take apart a desktop PC, inspect its components, and dive deeper from the motherboard, CPU, cooling, storage and GPU all the way down to GPU architecture and individual streaming multiprocessors. Every component includes explanations, specifications and sources, with all 3D geometry generated directly in TypeScript and Three.js.

posts.name: Oscar Nutrição
posts.tagline: AI-powered personalized nutrition and meal planning
posts.description: Oscar Nutrição is an AI-powered nutrition platform for individuals and health professionals. It creates highly personalized meal plans using user or client profiles, considering goals, age, body data, activity, budget, preferences, restrictions, habits, diseases and health conditions. With separate user and client profiles, history, favorites and professional management tools, it turns complex nutritional needs into practical, personalized daily planning.

posts.name: AI Box
posts.tagline: Private AI for your business documents
posts.description: AI Box is a ready-to-use local AI appliance for private document search, Q&A, citations, and sensitive-document workflows.

posts.name: Duo
posts.tagline: An iPhone Duo simulator you can build apps for
posts.description: Inspired by Apple's iPhone Duo, Duo is a desktop simulator for exploring a phone that folds. Fold it, rotate it, and build apps for its inner and cover displays with a fold-aware SDK, React UI kit, and App Store. Try the browser preview for a taste of the experience.

posts.name: The Startup Intelligence Network
posts.tagline: Everything you need to build, launch and grow your startup
posts.description: Astracia is a Startup Intelligence Network connecting nearly 200,000 startups, market research, competitors, conversations and launch opportunities through Astra-GPT. Research any startup, uncover competitor strategies, track opportunities with Astracia Radar, and turn connected data into actionable insights. Explore 1,000+ places to launch, founder deals, checklists and a growing community — all working together to help you build, launch and grow.

posts.name: RECLIO
posts.tagline: Record your screen. Make it ready to send.
posts.description: Record your screen, make it look great, and share it in minutes. Reclio is a native macOS recorder with backgrounds, zoom, cursor effects and MP4 export, with no cloud needed. Built for team training, tutorials and workflow demos.

posts.name: AppHandle
posts.tagline: Build any app by describing it. No code required.
posts.description: AppHandle is the AI app builder for people who don't code. Describe what you need in plain language, track inventory, take bookings, run a classroom, send invoices, and get a working app with a data store, sign-in, and sharing already built in. Click any part of the UI to change it, no code required. Free to start, no subscription, and credits that never expire.

posts.name: Free Word Counter Tool
posts.tagline: Free online word counter, sentences and character counter.
posts.description: TakueWord Count is a fast, free, modern, and mobile-friendly online word-counting and text-analysis website.

posts.name: The Autonomous Security Tier MSPs Resell
posts.tagline: Helps you extend your service line
posts.description: EasySOC — the autonomous investigation engine MSPs resell. White-label 24×7 security monitoring that runs on the Microsoft 365 tenants you already manage. New recurring revenue, zero added headcount.

posts.name: Pagepod
posts.tagline: Save, Run, and Share Your HTML Apps Free & Get Links
posts.description: Pagepod is a zero-config hosting and showcase platform for HTML web applications. Safely save, run, and share your interactive tools, games, and frontend creations in an isolated sandbox with instant previews and clean embeddable widgets

posts.name: Pragmys
posts.tagline: Crack your developer dream job, with proof
posts.description: Pragmys is an AI Powered Developer analytics platform for growth & career. It turns your code into proof of what you can build. It analyzes your real repositories to create evidence-based skill profiles, then matches those demonstrated capabilities against the jobs you want. Instead of relying on resumes or coding puzzles, developers can understand how well a role fits their actual experience before applying and grow to crack their dream jobs.

posts.name: MarketMate
posts.tagline: Create ads, captions and campaigns in one workspace
posts.description: Spend less time on marketing and more time running your business. MarketMate turns your products and ideas into complete campaigns, with image ad creatives, editable captions, hashtags and a marketing calendar. Bring the planning, writing and design work into one workspace, built to save business owners time each week.

posts.name: Jev by Typesafe
posts.tagline: System One model for typed decisions, not chat
posts.description: Jev is TypeSafe AI's first System One frontier model: unstructured state in, typed probabilistic decisions out. Instead of generating text, Jev returns Choice, Score, and Noul answers with calibrated probabilities your code can act on. Parallel sampling delivers ~70-500ms responses, about 20-200x faster and 40-400x cheaper than comparable LLM workflows, with output tokens free. Early access via the waitlist on typesafe.ai.

posts.name: Mitamaton
posts.tagline: A chief of staff for your day, on one board.
posts.description: I put your calendar, mail, health, reminders and notes on one board, with a morning brief written from what is there. Hold a card to move or resize it, undo one change at a time. GPT-6 Astra in Codex wrote most of the code. Numbers in the first comment.

posts.name: Mercury Pitch
posts.tagline: Virtual rehearsal studio with instant performance feedback
posts.description: Free browser practice studio that hears you play — vocal pitch training, vocal range tests, karaoke with live scoring, and guitar, piano and drum rooms that show every note you hit.
